name: MM-MTBench
intro: MM-MT-Bench是一个多轮LLM-as-a-judge评估基准，类似于文本MT-Bench，用于测试多模态指令调优模型。现有基准测试（如MMMU、MathVista、ChartQA等）侧重于封闭式问题和简短回答，无法评估模型在多轮对话中遵循用户指令和零样本回答开放式问题的能力。MM-MT-Bench旨在克服这一限制。
build_method: 人工策展, 二次复核, LLM评判
task_type: 开放式问答, 多轮对话
intro_en: MM-MT-Bench is a multi-turn LLM-as-a-judge evaluation benchmark, similar to the text-based MT-Bench, designed to test multimodal instruction-tuned models. Existing benchmarks (such as MMMU, MathVista, ChartQA, etc.) focus on closed-ended questions and short answers, and cannot assess a model's ability to follow user instructions and provide zero-shot answers to open-ended questions in multi-turn dialogues. MM-MT-Bench aims to overcome this limitation.
mermaid_flowchart:
flowchart LR
    A[策展五类图像与实用场景] --> B[人工编写并二次复核问题和答案]
    B --> C[构建69个单轮、18个两轮、4个三轮和1个四轮对话]
    C --> D[确保每题必须依赖图像]
    D --> E[各轮使用标准历史答案独立作答]
    E --> F[GPT-4o按正确性与完整性给出1至10分]
    F --> G[汇总平均分并验证与视觉竞技场ELO的0.91相关性]
flowchart_en:
flowchart LR
    A["Select extraction, summarization, and image-reasoning use cases"] --> B["Curate charts, tables, PDF pages, diagrams, and miscellaneous images"]
    B --> C["Manually write prompts and reference answers"]
    C --> D["Have a second labeler group verify answers"]
    D --> E["Build 92 one-to-four-turn conversations"]
    E --> F["Require the image for every prompt"]
    F --> G["Answer each turn using gold past answers as history"]
    G --> H["Have GPT-4o independently judge every turn"]
    H --> I["Rate correctness and completeness from 1 to 10"]
    I --> J["Average ratings and compare with Vision Arena ELO"]

drawio_review_note: Aligned with arXiv:2410.07073 Section 3 and the official Mistral MM-MT-Bench dataset. The diagram preserves all five image categories and counts, manual image-prompt-answer curation, second-labeler verification, the exact 69 single-turn plus 18 two-turn plus four three-turn plus one four-turn distribution, mandatory image dependence, independent turn inference with gold prior-turn history, full-history GPT-4o judging, 1-to-10 correctness and completeness ratings, mean score reporting, and the paper's 0.91 Vision Arena ELO correlation.
